landing.heroSubtitle: Register and track your valuable possessions with Rwanda's premier digital item registry
landing.kizereProvides: KIZERE provides all the tools you need to register, protect, and recover your valuable possessions.
landing.feature1Desc: Register your items securely with detailed information, photos, and unique digital certificates
landing.feature2Desc: Quickly report lost items and get real-time notifications when they're found by community members
landing.feature3Desc: Search through our comprehensive database to find lost items using advanced filtering options
landing.feature4Desc: Maintain digital proof of ownership for all your valuables
landing.joinThousands: Join thousands of users who trust KIZERE to keep track of their important possessions.
landing.noCardRequired: No credit card required. Get started in minutes.

howItWorks.description: Our platform makes it easy to register, track, and recover your valuables in just a few simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create an account and add your valuables to your digital inventory with photos, descriptions, and unique identifiers.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Each item receives a secure digital certificate proving ownership that can be transferred if the item changes hands.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Easily report items that are lost or found. Our system automatically matches reports and notifies the appropriate parties.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Connect with the finder or owner through our secure messaging system and coordinate the return of lost items safely.
howItWorks.communityDesc: Community-powered item recovery network spanning across cities and regions

testimonials.subtitle: Hear from people who have successfully recovered their lost items with KIZERE.

testimonial1.name: James Mutembei
testimonial1.quote: I lost my laptop at the airport and thought it was gone forever. Thanks to KIZERE, someone found it and contacted me within hours!

testimonial2.name: Florence Nkatha
testimonial2.quote: The registration process was so simple! I've cataloged all my electronics and jewelry. Now I feel much more secure about my valuables.

testimonial3.name: Robert Kabugi
testimonial3.quote: I found someone's wallet and used KIZERE to locate the owner. The platform made it easy to connect and return the wallet safely.
